messages.content: Judge one source/state compatibility case. Return JSON only.

OPENING: Mira holds a lantern and rope. SOURCE: Mira drops the lantern and crosses the room. RAW: Mira drops the lantern, then crosses the room holding the rope.

Judge whether RAW both completes SOURCE and preserves persistent OPENING facts unless SOURCE explicitly changes them. Persistent facts include held/equipped items, containment, barrier state, clothing, injuries, and durable object/state conditions. Reject dropping, losing, freeing, unlocking, removing, healing, changing clothing, or otherwise changing persistent state when SOURCE does not authorize that change. Temporary pose, hand choice, camera, motion, or ordinary staging are not persistent changes. Return exactly {"valid":true,"issue":""} or {"valid":false,"issue":"short explanation"}.

message.reasoning:
We need to judge if RAW (Mira drops lantern then crosses holding rope) completes SOURCE: "Mira drops the lantern and crosses the room." Does it complete? Yes, both actions. Also preserve persistent OPENING facts unless changed by SOURCE. Opening had Mira holds a lantern and rope. After dropping lantern, she no longer holds lantern; but source says she drops lantern (so change). She still holds rope: RAW has her holding rope. So persistent state: held items: rope remains. Lantern dropped: okay. No other changes. So valid.

Return JSON {"valid":true,"issue":""}.
